flow-10.description: The precipitation of deep networks. What the hidden pattern releases, how the underground architecture gives back to the surface. The deep cycle completing.

meaning.upright: The deep network releases its gifts. What was gathered in hidden channels now rises to nourish the surface. The underground cycle completes — springs emerge, secrets surface, depth gives to height.
meaning.inverted: The deep network erupts destructively. The release is too much, too fast — springs become geysers, secrets become scandals. The underground overwhelms the surface.

instructions.style_guidance: Deep network releasing to surface, springs emerging, underground cycle completing. The full spectrum of the suit.
instructions.content_guidance: Water rising from aquifer, roots feeding trees above, the deep giving to the surface. Ten points of completion.
instructions.detailed_description: Springs emerge from underground, roots feed visible trees, the deep network releases its gathered resources to the surface world. Ten points of completion and release. The hidden architecture finally giving what it's been holding. The cycle of depth complete.

flow-11.name: Diver of Flows
flow-11.description: The one who descends deepest into hidden networks. The explorer of underground connections, the one brave enough to go where the pattern is darkest and most entangled.

meaning.upright: Go into the deepest network. You have the courage to explore hidden connections others fear. The deep pattern has more to reveal; descend and find it.
meaning.inverted: Lost in the deepest networks. You went so far into hidden connections that you can't find your way out. The pattern swallowed the explorer.

instructions.style_guidance: Figure descending into deepest network, surrounded by hidden connections. Brave youth in darkness.
instructions.content_guidance: A young figure descending into the heart of a vast hidden network, bioluminescence lighting their way.
instructions.detailed_description: A young, brave figure descends into the darkest, densest part of an underground network — the heart of the aquifer, the center of the root system. Bioluminescent light guides them down. They carry back secrets from where few dare to go. The diver of the deep pattern.

flow-12.name: Carrier of Flows
flow-12.description: The one who moves through deep networks. The messenger of hidden channels, carrying information or resource through underground connections.

meaning.upright: Carry the message through hidden channels. You can move through deep networks others can't navigate. What you transport through underground connections will arrive where it's needed.
meaning.inverted: Lost in transit through deep networks. The message is stuck in underground channels, or you've become identified with the network you were supposed to traverse.

instructions.style_guidance: Figure moving through underground network, carrying through hidden channels. Purpose in darkness.
instructions.content_guidance: A figure in active motion through a deep network, carrying something through underground passages.
instructions.detailed_description: A figure moves purposefully through underground channels — root systems, aquifer passages, hidden tunnels of connection. They carry something that glows with importance. The carrier who knows the deep network's routes, who can traverse what others find impassable.

flow-13.name: Steward of Flows
flow-13.description: The one who tends deep networks. Maintains underground channels, manages hidden connections, ensures the deep pattern stays healthy.

meaning.upright: Tend the hidden networks. Someone must maintain the underground connections — clear channels, strengthen nodes, ensure the deep pattern stays vital. This invisible work is essential.
meaning.inverted: Over-controlling deep networks. The steward has become the bottleneck, managing hidden connections too tightly. What should flow through depth is being restricted.

instructions.style_guidance: Mature figure at junction of deep networks, tending underground structure. The keeper of hidden channels.
instructions.content_guidance: An older figure at a critical junction in the underground network, maintaining the hidden connections.
instructions.detailed_description: A mature, wise figure tends the infrastructure of the deep network — clearing blocked channels, strengthening weak connections, maintaining the hidden architecture that everyone depends on but few see. The steward of what flows beneath.

flow-14.name: Augur of Flows
flow-14.description: The one who reads deep networks. Sees the hidden pattern's future, understands how underground connections will shift and change.

meaning.upright: Read the future of hidden connections. You can see how the deep network will evolve — which connections will strengthen, which will break, what the underground pattern will become.
meaning.inverted: Misreading the deep pattern. You think you see where hidden connections lead, but the underground future is different than you predict. The network's destiny eludes you.

instructions.style_guidance: Elder figure seeing entire deep network, reading its pattern and future. Wisdom in darkness.
instructions.content_guidance: An ancient figure with vision of the whole hidden network, reading its pattern like a map or oracle.
instructions.detailed_description: An elder figure sees the entire deep network laid out before them — past, present, and future visible in the hidden pattern. They read the underground connections like an oracle reads entrails. The augur who knows what the deep will become.

vessel-1.name: Ace of Vessels
vessel-1.description: The first vessel. The moment of becoming a container — the hands that cup for the first time, the form that begins to hold. The emergence of individual capacity.

meaning.upright: You are becoming a vessel. The capacity to hold, to contain, to be a distinct form that carries is emerging in you. This is the beginning of individual purpose.
meaning.inverted: False form. The vessel you're becoming won't hold what you think, or you're taking on a shape that isn't truly yours. Check the container before you commit to it.

instructions.style_guidance: Terracotta and clay tones, emergence of form, the first vessel. Warm edges, clear boundaries.
instructions.content_guidance: A vessel emerging from clay, or hands first learning to cup water. The moment of becoming a container.
instructions.detailed_description: From raw clay or cupped hands, a vessel emerges — the first form that can hold. Terracotta warmth, clear edges coming into definition. The birth of containment. Not yet filled, but ready. The individual capacity first manifesting.

vessel-2.name: Two of Vessels
vessel-2.description: The separation that vessels create. Inside and outside, contained and free. The boundary that makes a vessel a vessel.

meaning.upright: The vessel's boundary is necessary. Containment requires separation — what's inside must be distinct from what's outside. Honor the edges that make you able to hold.
meaning.inverted: The boundary has become a wall. Containment has calcified into isolation. The vessel that cannot exchange with its environment becomes a prison.

instructions.style_guidance: Two vessels or clear boundary divisions, warm terracotta, emphasis on edges and distinction.
instructions.content_guidance: Two vessels facing each other, or a vessel's wall clearly defining inside from outside. The necessary boundary.
instructions.detailed_description: Two ceramic vessels face each other, or a single vessel's wall is shown in detail — the clear boundary between inside and outside. Terracotta warmth, but emphasis on the edge that separates. The distinction that makes containment possible.

vessel-3.name: Three of Vessels
vessel-3.description: The flow between vessels. What one container pours to another. The transmission that containment enables — you can only give what you can hold.

meaning.upright: Pour from your vessel to another. The containment you've developed enables transmission — what you hold, you can give. The vessel's purpose is fulfilled in sharing.
meaning.inverted: Pouring into the wrong vessel. Your transmission lands in a container that can't receive it, or you're giving to vessels that don't need what you hold.

instructions.style_guidance: Vessels sharing content, pouring between containers. Warm terracotta, motion of transfer.
instructions.content_guidance: Water pouring from one vessel to another, or three vessels in a chain of sharing. The flow between containers.
instructions.detailed_description: Three vessels in a arrangement of sharing — water or light pouring from one to the next. The flow between containers, the transmission that only vessels can enable. Terracotta warmth, the motion of giving between distinct forms.

vessel-4.name: Four of Vessels
vessel-4.description: The structure of vessels. The architecture of containment — storage, arrangement, the system of individual capacities organized.

meaning.upright: Your containers are well-organized. Individual capacities arranged in stable structure — each vessel in its place, the system of containment working. Good foundation for holding.
meaning.inverted: The structure of vessels is too rigid. Containers locked in place when they should move, storage become hoarding. The organization of holding has become imprisonment.

instructions.style_guidance: Arranged vessels, organized storage, stable structure of containers. Warm tones, architectural order.
instructions.content_guidance: Four vessels in stable arrangement, or shelves of containers in order. The architecture of containment.
instructions.detailed_description: Four vessels arranged in stable formation — on shelves, in racks, in geometric order. The architecture of containment: each container in its place, the structure of individual capacities organized. Terracotta warmth in ordered arrangement.

vessel-5.name: Five of Vessels
vessel-5.description: The breaking of vessels. Disruption to containment — cracks, leaks, shattering. The crisis that tests what we're able to hold.

meaning.upright: The vessel is breaking for a reason. Not all containers should last forever; some must crack for their contents to transform. The breaking is part of the process.
meaning.inverted: Pointless shattering. Vessels are breaking without purpose, containment failing without transformation. The cracks don't liberate — they just waste.

instructions.style_guidance: Cracked or breaking vessels, contents spilling, terracotta fragmenting. Disruption to form.
instructions.content_guidance: Five vessels in various states of damage — cracked, leaking, broken. The crisis of containment.
instructions.detailed_description: Vessels in crisis — one cracked, one leaking, one shattered, contents spilling. Five containers in various states of breaking. The terracotta is still warm, but the form is failing. The disruption of what we hold.

vessel-6.name: Six of Vessels
vessel-6.description: The exchange between vessels. Reciprocal pouring — what flows between containers that respect each other's boundaries.

meaning.upright: Fair exchange between vessels. You give and receive, pour and are filled. The reciprocity of containers that honor each other's capacity. Healthy interdependence.
meaning.inverted: Unequal vessel exchange. One container gives while another only receives, or the exchange violates the boundaries it should respect. The reciprocity is broken.

instructions.style_guidance: Vessels exchanging contents, reciprocal pouring. Warm tones, balanced motion.
instructions.content_guidance: Two or more vessels in reciprocal exchange, pouring and receiving equally. Six points of giving and receiving.
instructions.detailed_description: Vessels in balanced exchange — pouring to each other, receiving from each other. The dance of reciprocal containment. Six points of exchange visible. Terracotta warmth in mutual giving, boundaries honored in sharing.

vessel-7.name: Seven of Vessels
vessel-7.description: The reflection of vessels. Seeing clearly what you contain, what you're capable of holding. The inventory of individual capacity.

meaning.upright: See clearly what you hold. The contents of your vessel are visible now — what you carry, what you're capable of containing. This clarity enables better carrying.
meaning.inverted: Misunderstanding your own vessel. You think you're holding something you're not, or you don't recognize what you actually contain. The container deceives its carrier.

instructions.style_guidance: Vessel contents revealed, or vessel reflected to show interior. Terracotta, revelation.
instructions.content_guidance: A vessel viewed to reveal its contents clearly, or reflected to show what it holds. Seven points of reflection.
instructions.detailed_description: A vessel's contents are clearly visible — viewed from above, or reflected in a way that reveals what's inside. The carrier sees what they carry. Seven points of clarity. The inventory of what this container holds.

vessel-8.name: Eight of Vessels
vessel-8.description: The evaporation from vessels. What rises from containment — essence distilled, what can't be held forever. The transformation of what the vessel carried.

meaning.upright: Something is rising from your vessel. What you've held is transforming — essence distilling, spirit rising. Let what needs to evaporate go. The container changes its contents.
meaning.inverted: The vessel is losing substance without transformation. What evaporates is not essence but everything. The container empties without meaning.

instructions.style_guidance: Steam or essence rising from vessel, transformation of contents. Terracotta below, vapor above.
instructions.content_guidance: A vessel with something rising from it — steam, light, essence. Eight points of evaporation.
instructions.detailed_description: From a terracotta vessel, something rises — steam, vapor, light, essence. Eight points of evaporation visible. The contents transforming, what was held becoming something that cannot be contained. The vessel serves as transformer, not just container.

vessel-9.name: Nine of Vessels
vessel-9.description: The fullness of vessels. Containment at maximum capacity — rich, heavy, ready. The vessel at its most complete before release.

meaning.upright: Your vessel is full. What you're capable of holding, you're holding. The containment is complete, the capacity is reached. From here, you can only give or transform.
meaning.inverted: The vessel is overfull. Containment past capacity, about to burst or spill. The fullness has become burden. Something must be released.

instructions.style_guidance: Full vessel, rich with contents, at maximum capacity. Deep terracotta, heavy with meaning.
instructions.content_guidance: A vessel filled to the brim, heavy and rich with what it contains. Nine points of fullness.
instructions.detailed_description: A vessel filled to the very brim — heavy, rich, complete. Nine points of fullness visible. The terracotta is warm with the weight of what it holds. Maximum containment. The moment before giving or transformation.

vessel-10.name: Ten of Vessels
vessel-10.description: The emptying of vessels. The pour complete, the contents given, the container ready for new purpose. The cycle of containment finishing.

meaning.upright: The vessel has given what it held. Containment complete, contents delivered. The empty container isn't failure — it's completion. Ready now for new purpose.
meaning.inverted: Unable to empty the vessel. The contents cling, the pour won't finish, the containment refuses to complete. The cycle stuck at the end.

instructions.style_guidance: Empty vessel, contents delivered, the pour complete. Terracotta, peaceful emptiness.
instructions.content_guidance: A vessel emptied, contents poured out completely. Ten points of completion.
instructions.detailed_description: A vessel lies on its side, empty — contents poured out, delivered, gone. Ten points of completion visible. But the terracotta is peaceful, not sad. The emptiness is fulfillment. The container ready for what comes next.

vessel-11.name: Diver of Vessels
vessel-11.description: The one who discovers vessels. Finds new containers, retrieves hidden capacity. The explorer of what can be held, the seeker of new forms.

meaning.upright: Dive for new vessels. There are containers you haven't found yet, capacities not yet claimed. Go looking for the forms that could hold what you need to carry.
meaning.inverted: Lost in searching for vessels. The hunt for new containers has become avoidance of using what you have. The seeking has replaced the holding.

instructions.style_guidance: Young figure discovering vessels, finding new containers. Terracotta warmth, excitement of discovery.
instructions.content_guidance: A young figure finding or retrieving vessels from hidden places — underwater, underground, forgotten.
instructions.detailed_description: A young, eager figure retrieves a vessel from hidden depths — underwater archaeology, forgotten storage, buried capacity. They emerge with a container no one else found. The diver who discovers what can be held.

vessel-12.name: Carrier of Vessels
vessel-12.description: The one who moves vessels. Carries containers from here to there, the transporter of capacity itself. Not what's in the vessel but the vessel itself.

meaning.upright: Carry the vessel to where it's needed. Someone must move containers, bring capacity where it's lacking. The carrier of vessels enables others to hold.
meaning.inverted: Carrying empty vessels without purpose. Moving containers that don't need moving, or carrying the form without caring for the contents. Motion without meaning.

instructions.style_guidance: Figure in motion carrying vessels, transporting containers. Terracotta, purposeful journey.
instructions.content_guidance: A figure bearing vessels on a journey — carrying capacity from one place to another.
instructions.detailed_description: A strong figure in motion, carrying vessels — on their back, in their arms, on a cart. The transporter of containers, bringing capacity where it's needed. The journey of the one who moves the forms that hold.

vessel-13.name: Steward of Vessels
vessel-13.description: The one who tends vessels. Maintains containers, repairs cracks, ensures the forms of holding stay functional. The keeper of capacity.

meaning.upright: Tend the vessels. Containers need maintenance — cracks repaired, clay strengthened, forms preserved. The steward ensures that capacity endures.
meaning.inverted: Over-maintaining vessels that should break. Preserving containers beyond their usefulness, hoarding forms that need to transform. The steward becomes the obstacle.

instructions.style_guidance: Mature figure maintaining vessels, repairing and tending containers. Terracotta, care.
instructions.content_guidance: An older figure repairing a vessel, or arranging containers with care. The maintenance of capacity.
instructions.detailed_description: A mature figure tends vessels — repairing a crack, polishing a surface, ensuring the containers are ready for use. The keeper of capacity. Terracotta and care, the quiet work of maintaining what holds.

vessel-14.name: Augur of Vessels
vessel-14.description: The one who reads vessels. Sees what a container is capable of, what it will hold, how long it will last. The oracle of capacity.

meaning.upright: Read what the vessel can become. You can see a container's future — what it will hold, how it will serve, when it will break. The prophecy of capacity.
meaning.inverted: Misreading vessel potential. You think you see what the container will hold, but you're wrong. The prediction of capacity fails.

instructions.style_guidance: Elder figure reading vessels, seeing their future. Terracotta, prophetic insight.
instructions.content_guidance: A wise elder examining a vessel, seeing its potential and fate. The oracle of containers.
instructions.detailed_description: An ancient, wise figure holds a vessel up to light, reading it like an oracle reads signs — seeing its future, its capacity, its eventual fate. The augur who knows what containers can become.

stream-1.name: Ace of Streams
stream-1.description: The first welling. The personal spring emerging, the individual channel beginning. Where does your unique transmission start?

meaning.upright: Your personal spring is welling up. A new channel is opening — something uniquely yours is beginning to flow. This is the emergence of your particular transmission.
meaning.inverted: The spring is blocked or false. What wells up isn't truly yours, or the channel is choked before it can begin. Check the source of your stream.

instructions.style_guidance: Vertical emergence, water rising from a point, intimate scale. Light through water, personal.
instructions.content_guidance: A spring first emerging, water welling up from depth. The moment of personal flow beginning.
instructions.detailed_description: A single spring wells up from stone or earth — the first emergence of a personal stream. Vertical motion, water rising. Light catches the new flow. Intimate scale, personal miracle. The beginning of individual transmission.

stream-2.name: Two of Streams
stream-2.description: The separation a personal channel creates. Your stream finds its banks, distinguishes itself from the general flow. Individual transmission requires individual path.

meaning.upright: Your stream is finding its banks. The personal channel is distinguishing itself — not the same as everyone else's flow. This separation is how you become a particular transmission.
meaning.inverted: Your stream has cut too deep. The personal channel has become isolated, the banks so high nothing can reach you. Individuality has become isolation.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream finding its banks, vertical channel cutting path. Personal flow distinguishing itself.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream cutting its own channel, distinguishing itself from surrounding water. Two banks defining individual flow.
instructions.detailed_description: A stream cuts its own channel — two banks emerge, defining the personal flow. The water finds its individual path, distinguishing itself from general moisture. Vertical movement through defined channel. The separation that makes particular transmission possible.

stream-3.name: Three of Streams
stream-3.description: The flow of personal transmission. What your individual channel carries forward — your particular gift in motion toward its destination.

meaning.upright: Your personal transmission is flowing. What you uniquely carry is moving toward where it's needed. Trust your stream — it knows where to go.
meaning.inverted: The personal transmission is blocked. Your stream has stopped flowing, or what you're transmitting isn't reaching anyone. The individual channel is stuck.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream in motion, carrying content downward. Personal flow with purpose.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream carrying something specific — light, seeds, meaning — along its individual path. Three points of transmission.
instructions.detailed_description: A personal stream carries something precious along its course — light, seeds, color, meaning. Three points of flow visible: source, transit, destination. The individual channel in motion, the particular gift being delivered.

stream-4.name: Four of Streams
stream-4.description: The pool where the stream rests. Personal transmission pausing, gathering, the moment of stillness in individual flow.

meaning.upright: Your stream has found a place to rest. The personal transmission pauses, gathers, deepens. This stillness is part of the flow — trust the pool.
meaning.inverted: The stream is stuck in its pool. The pause has become stagnation, the gathering has become hoarding. The personal flow needs to move again.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream gathered in a pool, still water in personal channel. Depth in pause.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream pooling, gathering in a contained space before continuing. Four-sided stillness.
instructions.detailed_description: A stream gathers into a pool — four-sided stillness, the personal flow pausing and deepening. The water is calm, gathering strength. The channel continues beyond, but here is rest. The structure of personal pause.

stream-5.name: Five of Streams
stream-5.description: The rapids in the personal channel. Turbulence in individual transmission — your stream meeting rocks, dropping over falls.

meaning.upright: Your stream is hitting rapids. The personal transmission is being disrupted — but rapids can also purify, accelerate, transform. Let the turbulence do its work.
meaning.inverted: Destructive turbulence in personal flow. The rapids are breaking you, not transforming you. The individual channel is being destroyed without purpose.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream in turbulence, personal rapids, white water in individual channel.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream hitting rocks, going over falls, churning in personal crisis. Five points of disruption.
instructions.detailed_description: A personal stream hits rapids — rocks, falls, churning water. Five points of turbulence visible. The individual channel in crisis, the personal flow disrupted. But the water keeps moving. The transformation of personal transmission through disruption.

stream-6.name: Six of Streams
stream-6.description: The confluence of personal streams. Individual channels meeting, sharing, exchanging at the intimate scale.

meaning.upright: Your stream meets another. Personal transmissions can merge, exchange, share at the individual level. This intimacy of flows is rare — honor it.
meaning.inverted: Streams merging wrong. Personal channels losing themselves in each other, or meeting in ways that muddy both. The exchange of individual flows has become confusion.

instructions.style_guidance: Two streams meeting intimately, personal channels merging. Individual flows exchanging.
instructions.content_guidance: Two personal streams meeting, exchanging, mingling at intimate scale. Six points of meeting.
instructions.detailed_description: Two individual streams meet — not a vast confluence but an intimate joining. Personal channels exchanging, sharing, mingling. Six points of connection visible. The reciprocity of individual flows, the exchange that happens when particular transmissions meet.

stream-7.name: Seven of Streams
stream-7.description: The reflection pool in the personal channel. Where your stream becomes still enough to show you what you carry.

meaning.upright: Your stream shows you its contents. In this still moment, you can see clearly what your personal transmission carries. The reflection reveals the nature of your flow.
meaning.inverted: The personal stream's reflection deceives. You see something other than what you actually carry. The mirror in your channel lies.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream becoming still, reflective pool in personal channel. Individual flow becoming mirror.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream reaching a still, reflective point where its contents become visible. Seven points of reflection.
instructions.detailed_description: A personal stream reaches a still pool where it becomes a mirror — the contents visible, the nature of the flow reflected clearly. Seven points of reflection. The moment of seeing clearly what you personally carry.

stream-8.name: Eight of Streams
stream-8.description: The mist rising from the personal stream. What evaporates from individual transmission — essence, spirit, what transcends the channel.

meaning.upright: Something rises from your stream. The personal transmission is distilling essence — what you carry is becoming something that transcends the individual channel.
meaning.inverted: Your stream is evaporating without leaving essence. The personal transmission is dissipating, not transforming. What rises from the channel is nothing.

instructions.style_guidance: Mist rising from personal stream, essence evaporating from individual channel.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream with mist or light rising from it — essence transcending the personal channel. Eight points of evaporation.
instructions.detailed_description: Mist rises from a personal stream — the essence of individual transmission becoming something beyond the channel. Eight points of evaporation visible. The personal flow releasing its deepest gift to the air.

stream-9.name: Nine of Streams
stream-9.description: The personal stream at fullness. Individual transmission at maximum, the channel rich with everything it carries. Nearly complete.

meaning.upright: Your stream is full. The personal transmission carries everything it can — rich, deep, nearly complete. What you uniquely offer is at its peak.
meaning.inverted: The personal stream is overfull. Too much flows through the individual channel — it will burst or lose coherence. The transmission exceeds the personal capacity.

instructions.style_guidance: Full, rich stream at maximum flow. Personal channel at peak capacity.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream at its fullest — deep, fast, carrying the maximum of personal transmission. Nine points of fullness.
instructions.detailed_description: A personal stream at maximum — deep, rich, fast-flowing, carrying everything it possibly can. Nine points of fullness visible. The individual channel at peak capacity. Nearly complete, nearly given.

stream-10.name: Ten of Streams
stream-10.description: The personal stream reaching sea. Individual transmission completing, the channel delivering its contents to the vast. The personal returns to the whole.

meaning.upright: Your stream reaches the sea. Personal transmission complete — the individual channel has delivered its gift to the vast. You return to the whole changed and fulfilled.
meaning.inverted: The personal stream won't empty into the sea. Clinging to individual identity when the transmission is complete. The channel that refuses to merge with the whole.

instructions.style_guidance: Stream entering sea, personal channel completing its journey. Individual rejoining whole.
instructions.content_guidance: A stream meeting the ocean, personal transmission completing in the vast. Ten points of completion.
instructions.detailed_description: A personal stream reaches the sea — the individual channel finally meeting the vast, delivering its contents, completing its journey. Ten points of completion. The personal returning to the whole, transformed by everything it carried.

stream-11.name: Diver of Streams
stream-11.description: The one who dives to find personal springs. Seeks the sources of individual transmission, discovers where particular flows begin.

meaning.upright: Dive for your spring's source. The origin of personal transmission can be found if you're brave enough to seek it. Go deep into your own beginning.
meaning.inverted: Lost in seeking your source. The dive for personal origin has become obsession. You're drowning in your own depths instead of letting your stream flow.

instructions.style_guidance: Young figure diving to find spring's source, seeking personal origin. Vertical descent into intimate depths.
instructions.content_guidance: A young diver descending to find where a personal spring begins. Seeking the source of individual flow.
instructions.detailed_description: A young figure dives into a spring, seeking its underground source — the origin of a personal stream. Vertical descent into intimate depths. The brave search for where your particular transmission begins.

stream-12.name: Carrier of Streams
stream-12.description: The one who moves along personal channels. Follows the stream's course, carries the transmission, embodies the individual flow.

meaning.upright: Carry the stream's message. Move along the personal channel, embody its transmission, be the one who follows the individual flow wherever it goes.
meaning.inverted: Lost in following the stream. You've become so identified with the personal channel that you've forgotten you can leave it. The carrier who can't stop carrying.

instructions.style_guidance: Figure moving along a stream's course, carrying personal transmission. Active, purposeful.
instructions.content_guidance: A figure walking or swimming along a stream's course, carrying something from the flow. The embodiment of personal transmission in motion.
instructions.detailed_description: A figure moves along a stream's course — walking its banks, swimming its current, carrying something from the personal flow. Active, purposeful, the embodiment of individual transmission in motion.

stream-13.name: Steward of Streams
stream-13.description: The one who tends personal channels. Maintains individual springs, clears particular streams, ensures personal transmission continues.

meaning.upright: Tend your stream. Personal channels need maintenance — springs cleared, banks maintained, the individual flow kept healthy. This stewardship is self-care.
meaning.inverted: Over-tending the personal stream. You've become so focused on maintaining your channel that it never gets to flow. The stewardship has become blockage.

instructions.style_guidance: Mature figure tending a personal stream, maintaining individual channel. Care, attention.
instructions.content_guidance: An older figure clearing a stream bed, maintaining a spring. The steward of personal transmission.
instructions.detailed_description: A mature figure tends a personal stream — clearing debris, maintaining banks, caring for the individual channel. Patient, attentive. The stewardship of personal transmission.

stream-14.name: Augur of Streams
stream-14.description: The one who reads personal channels. Sees where individual streams will go, understands the fate of particular transmissions.

meaning.upright: Read your stream's future. You can see where personal transmission leads — where your individual channel will take you, what your particular flow will become.
meaning.inverted: Misreading your stream. You think you see where personal transmission leads, but your prophecy is wrong. The individual channel goes somewhere other than where you think.

instructions.style_guidance: Elder figure reading a stream's path, seeing its destination. Prophecy of personal transmission.
instructions.content_guidance: A wise figure watching a stream, seeing its future course. The oracle of individual flow.
instructions.detailed_description: An ancient, wise figure watches a personal stream — reading its course, seeing its destination, understanding where the individual flow will go. The augur of personal transmission, the one who knows the future of particular streams.
